name: uit-university
description: University of Integrated Thought (UIT) — official website and content management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w server && npm run db:deploy -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
